description: Append-only, evidence-led taxonomy extension for underrepresented operational, ecological, temporal, and visual-structure photography topics.

scene_action_templates: reacting as a previously ambiguous physical trace becomes visible during {action}
showing the immediate material, environmental, or human consequence after {action}

evidence_budget.guidance: one observable process, one physical prop or trace, and at most one additional evidence clue

preset_families.ko: 사람과 운영 시스템 증거 프리셋 계열
preset_families.en: human and operational system evidence preset family
preset_families.embedding_text: evidence-led documentary photography of people, tools, coordinated work, access, movement, handoffs, inspection and learning

preset_families.ko: 환경과 물질 과정 증거 프리셋 계열
preset_families.en: environment and material process evidence preset family
preset_families.embedding_text: repeatable photographic observation of ecological, atmospheric, heritage, material, spatial and natural-process state evidence

presets.embedding_text: loading dock forklift and spotter handoff documentary with a secured dockboard, wheel chock, marked pedestrian boundary and visible pallet transfer state
community wildfire smoke and haze monitoring with a collocated air-sensor pair, a fixed distant landmark, visible light loss and documented siting context
museum collection object condition documentation with padded support, fixed scale reference, raking light, mapped surface anomalies and optional multiview photogrammetry
person-centered assistive product fitting and follow-up with an adult user, adjustable walking aid, functional hand contact, user feedback and dignified community rehabilitation context
accessible public-building route record showing usable circulation, tactile walking surface indicators, threshold clearance and practical wayfinding without readable signage

presets.ko: 스포츠 접촉 전 예측 동작 기록
presets.embedding_text: sports biomechanics frame isolating pre-contact anticipation, gaze, weight shift and clear opponent or equipment clearance before impact
sports impact frame where athlete, equipment and surface meet at one plausible contact point with compression, rebound or displaced material responding to the same force event
post-exertion sports recovery frame with deceleration, breathing reset, stable posture and venue evidence rather than generic sweat or motion blur
workplace or maker-space learning record with adult mentor and learner, one visible task step, shared gaze, tool contact, practice workpiece and competency evidence
returned durable product intake assessment showing service wear, diagnostic contact, removed suspect component and a visible route toward direct reuse, refurbishment or material recovery
timed pollinator transect observation showing flower contacts, flowering patch boundaries, habitat context and a human-observation protocol without staged wildlife cues
post-harvest produce cold-chain handoff with batch temperature probing, ventilated shipping crates, precooling state and loading transfer continuity

presets.ko: 폭풍 후 건물 안전 점검 기록
presets.embedding_text: post-storm building-envelope safety survey with a cordoned observation boundary, wind and water damage interface, geometric non-readable status marker and georeferenced condition evidence
ground-truth meteorological observation of hail, frost, dust or deposited particles on a fixed exposure reference with safe post-event measurement
repeat photography of one place from a stable viewpoint with a fixed spatial anchor and visible preparation, active use, closure, maintenance, seasonal transition or reopening state

single-frame evidence of natural process through biological soil crust, erosion and deposition, condensation boundary, seed radicle emergence or freeze-thaw soil traces with scale and substrate context

photographic visual structure study using a clear figure-ground boundary, physically consistent occlusion, repeated rhythm with one break, contact residue, material-state transition or canonical size anchor
